This established medical practice, situated in a thriving coastal suburb of New South Wales, is seeking a dedicated General Practitioner to join its vibrant and rapidly growing team. The clinic offers a modern and supportive environment where practitioners enjoy full clinical autonomy, allowing them to focus entirely on high-quality patient care. Located within a major shopping precinct, the facility is highly accessible and features fifteen consulting rooms along with a fully equipped, modernized four-bed treatment room. The practice is technology-driven, utilizing Best Practice software and HotDoc for seamless online appointments, while offering onsite pathology and allied health services for comprehensive patient management. 

 The team composition is young and energetic, guided by seasoned medical practitioners at the management level who are committed to the holistic growth of their staff. Doctors are supported by an experienced nursing team and a proficient administrative department, with dedicated assistance available for Chronic Disease Management (CDM) and complex care coordination. For those interested in professional advancement, the practice provides ample support for Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and offers pathways for clinical leadership and supervisor opportunities. Practitioners with special interests are encouraged to develop their niche within the diverse and expanding patient base. 

 Financial rewards and lifestyle balance are key features of this role, with a competitive billing structure of 70% to 75% and a minimum income guarantee. The practice offers significant flexibility, including various working arrangements and remote access to accommodate individual needs. As a DPA/MM1 location, it presents an excellent opportunity for both permanent and locum doctors to establish themselves in a high-demand area. 

 The lifestyle benefits of the Shellharbour region are exceptional, making it a premier destination for families and outdoor enthusiasts alike. Practitioners can enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle with easy access to stunning beaches, the vibrant village waterfront, and scenic nature reserves such as Bass Point and Killalea State Park. With excellent local schools, diverse dining options, and a friendly community atmosphere, the location provides the perfect balance between a rewarding professional career and a high quality of life by the sea. Supportive and collaborative work environment  
  Full time and part time roles - Monday to Friday  
  Provide expert support to VMOs during Cath lab procedures  
 
 Nepean Private Hospital is currently looking for a motivated, enthusiastic experienced Registered Nurses to join our close-knit, friendly and hardworking Cath Lab team on a full-time or part-time basis.    About us    Nepean Private Hospital is in the multi-cultural Western Sydney City of Penrith. The hospital is a modern 109 bed facility providing a wide range of health services to the local community since 2000 including: orthopaedics, spinal, gynaecology, ENT, plastics, urology and general surgery, endoscopy, cardiology, cardiac angiography and obstetrics. Nepean Private Hospital has eight operating theatres, one hybrid/cardiac catheterisation theatre and an endoscopy suite, supported by a critical care unit which includes intensive care.  Nepean Private Hospital has established an excellent reputation in the community for its high commitment to customer service, staff satisfaction and quality improvement. Key to the hospital's success is a highly skilled and expert team of staff who are supported by a comprehensive range of professional development opportunities.   As a Registered Cath Lab Nurse your responsibilities will include:  
 
 Deliver safe, researched-based standards of nursing care 
 Collaborate with the Cath Lab team on coronary angiograms, pacemakers, vascular procedures and more 
 Lead successful quality improvement and safety management project/s to deliver desired outcomes 
 Work collaboratively with the wider healthcare team to support patient care needs 
 Act as a role model for Safe Practice 
 
  Essential Criteria:  
 
 Minimum 2 years' clinical experience in Cath Lab 
 Working with Children check 
 Bachelor of Nursing 
 Current Registration (no restriction) with AHPRA 
 Compliance with ACQSHC National standards 
 Clinical expertise and commitment to high quality patient care and continuous improvement 
 Self-motivated and proven ability to work as part of a high functioning team 
 Highly developed interpersonal skills, proactive, motivated and customer focused 
 
  Desirable Criteria:  
 
 Post Graduate Certificate in Cardiac Care (or working towards) 
 Advanced Life Support Certificate 
 
  Why Healthscope?   When you join Healthscope, you become part of our  Community of Care . Our people are at the heart of our organisation - no matter the role, every day  our people make a difference  to the lives of our patients and their families. As the only national private hospital operator and healthcare provider in Australia, our sites are supported by our central Support Office, enabling them to provide an exceptional experience for the communities we care for.   You'll also benefit from:  
 
 Flexibility to work across one or multiple hospitals across our network. 
 Discounted health insurance (non-casuals only) 
 Continuous professional development, education & support provided to encourage growth 
 
 We pride ourselves on working with  talented, passionate and caring  people to ensure our patients receive the highest quality care and experience during their stay with us. We support each other, share learnings, celebrate successes and face challenges together.    Come and be the difference in our patient's lives   .    If you are successful in the role, you will receive a salary based on your years of relevant registered nursing experience against the current Healthscope and NSWNMA/ANMF - NSW Nurses and Midwives' - Enterprise Agreement, a salary ranging from $40.26 -  $56.54  per hour.    Applications close:  30th July 2026   To Apply:  Please click on the 'Apply' button to be taken to our online application form. For any questions, please reach out to recruitment@healthscope.com.au   More Information:  Our commitment to quality and safety for our patients, staff and visitors is our highest priority. We are also committed to child safety. We are committed to the safety, participation and empowerment of all children. Applicants will be required to provide a current National Police check, WWCC (where applicable) and Evidence of right to work in Australia prior to appointment. Staff in patient contact roles will be required to provide proof of immunity to specified infectious diseases as a Category A Healthcare worker.   Healthscope has been made aware of recruitment scams involving individuals falsely claiming to represent Healthscope. Please note that Healthscope will never request payment from candidates. Any request for payment is fraudulent. Visit  ScamWatch  for more information on recruitment scams.  Please  click here  to apply.

Position Title: Retail Manager
Location: Kilkenny, South Australia
Employment Type: Full-time (38 hours per week)
Salary: $80,000 per annum + superannuation


About the Company

HHHLJ PTY LTD (as the trustee of Le Huynh Family Trust ABN 48 539 316 778 ) trading as Arndale Bakery is a South Australian family-owned bakery and wholesale supplier based in Kilkenny, providing a wide range of freshly baked products to restaurants, caterers, cafés and the local community. The business is committed to delivering consistent quality, reliable service and products that meet the needs of both commercial customers and local consumers.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to- day operations of Arndale Bakery’s retail outlet. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the retail team, maintaining high standards of customer service, managing stock and product presentation, supporting sales growth, and ensuring efficient store operations. This role is suited to a hands-on leader who can create a positive team environment and deliver an excellent experience for customers.


Key Responsibilities

- Plan, organise and manage the day-to-day operations of the bakery’s retail outlet.
- Determine the appropriate product range, stock levels, pricing and customer service standards.
- Monitor sales performance, operating costs and financial results to support business growth and profitability.
- Prepare and manage store budgets, sales targets and operational expenditure.
- Develop and implement purchasing, promotional and marketing strategies.
- Manage inventory, place orders and maintain accurate records of stock movements and financial transactions.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers, commercial customers and service providers.
- Recruit, train, roster, supervise and evaluate retail employees.
- Provide leadership and guidance to staff while maintaining a positive and productive workplace.
- Ensure customers receive professional service and appropriate advice regarding bakery products and orders.
- Manage customer feedback, complaints and service issues in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain high standards of product presentation, store cleanliness and merchandising.
- Ensure the retail outlet complies with food safety, workplace health and safety and other applicable operational requirements.
- Review store procedures and implement improvements to increase efficiency, sales and customer satisfaction.
- Coordinate with the bakery production team to ensure product availability, quality and timely fulfilment of customer orders.


Requirements

- Diploma-level qualification in retail management, business, hospitality or a related field, or at least three years of relevant management experience.
- Proven experience managing a retail store, bakery, café or similar business.
- Strong leadership skills, including staff supervision, rostering and training.
- Experience managing sales, budgets, stock, purchasing and supplier relationships.
- Excellent customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of food safety, workplace health and safety and retail operations.


How to Apply

Please submit your resume to resumes@wearefulcrum.com and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.
